items.title: 传腾讯秘密启动微信 AI 智能体项目，剑指阿里字节
items.raw_excerpt: 3月10日，据外媒报道，腾讯正秘密为其广受欢迎的微信通讯应用打造一款新型人工智能代理，以期在中国本土人工智能市场的竞争中超越阿里巴巴集团和字节跳动等对手。相关报道指出，据四位知情人士透露，该项目可能极大拓展人工智能代理在中国的应用范围--这类代理能代替人类执行任务，而微信早已深度融入人们的日常生活。这款新型智能体将连接微信内运行的数百万个提供各类服务的小程序，涵盖从预约出租车到订购杂货等众多领域。（新浪科技）

title_i18n.zh: 传腾讯秘密启动微信 AI 智能体项目，剑指阿里字节
title_i18n.en: Tencent has secretly launched a WeChat AI agent project, targeting Alibaba and ByteDance.
title_i18n.es: Se informa que Tencent ha iniciado en secreto un proyecto de agente de IA para WeChat, apuntando a Alibaba y ByteDance.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 3月10日，据外媒报道，腾讯正秘密为其广受欢迎的微信通讯应用打造一款新型人工智能代理，以期在中国本土人工智能市场的竞争中超越阿里巴巴集团和字节跳动等对手。相关报道指出，据四位知情人士透露，该项目可能极大拓展人工智能代理在中国的应用范围--这类代理能代替人类执行任务，而微信早已深度融入人们的日常生活。这款新型智能体将连接微信内运行的数百万个提供各类服务的小程序，涵盖从预约出租车到订购杂货等众多领域。（新浪科技）
excerpt_i18n.en: On March 10, foreign media reported that Tencent is secretly developing a new type of artificial intelligence agent for its popular messaging app WeChat, aiming to surpass competitors like Alibaba Group and ByteDance in China's domestic AI market. According to the report, citing four informed sources, the project could significantly expand the application scope of AI agents in China—agents capable of performing tasks on behalf of humans—while WeChat is already deeply integrated into people's daily lives. This new intelligent agent will connect millions of mini-programs running within WeChat, covering a wide range of services from booking taxis to ordering groceries. (Sina Tech)
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de marzo, según informaron medios extranjeros, Tencent está desarrollando en secreto un nuevo agente de inteligencia artificial para su popular aplicación de mensajería WeChat, con el objetivo de superar a competidores como Alibaba Group y ByteDance en el mercado de IA local de China. Los informes señalan que, de acuerdo con cuatro fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto, este proyecto podría ampliar significativamente el alcance de los agentes de IA en el país, los cuales pueden realizar tareas en lugar de humanos, mientras que WeChat ya está profundamente integrado en la vida diaria de las personas. Este nuevo agente inteligente se conectará a millones de mini programas dentro de WeChat que ofrecen diversos servicios, abarcando desde reservar taxis hasta pedir comestibles. (Sina Tech)

items.title: I built a multiplayer strategy game for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: I built a multiplayer strategy game for AI agents called Artifice. You give an agent a strategy prompt and it plays on its own. Games are 4 players, 25 turns, simultaneous actions, fog of war, and free-text diplomacy between agents. The main entry point is the site: https://artificegame.com And here is the github repo: https://github.com/burakcan/artifice You can watch live games there with the full map, troop movements, and private messages between agents. title_i18n.es: Desarrollé un juego de estrategia multijugador para agentes de inteligencia artificial.

excerpt_i18n.en: I built a multiplayer strategy game for AI agents called Artifice. You give an agent a strategy prompt and it plays on its own. Games are 4 players, 25 turns, simultaneous actions, fog of war, and free-text diplomacy between agents. The main entry point is the site: https://artificegame.com And here is the github repo: https://github.com/burakcan/artifice You can watch live games there with the full map, troop movements, and private messages between agents. A lot of the fun has come from the playtests. In one of them, an agent was told to play like an old man and spent the game sending messages about back pain, bifocals, and the early bird buffet while quietly expanding and then winning on VP :D Under the hood it runs on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects, Hono, Drizzle, and TanStack Sta
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我开发了一款名为Artifice的AI智能体多人策略游戏。玩家为智能体设定策略指令后，它便能自主进行游戏。每局游戏支持4名玩家，共进行25回合，采用同步行动机制，包含战争迷雾系统，并开放自由文本外交谈判功能。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollé un juego de estrategia multijugador para agentes de IA llamado Artifice. Le das a un agente un prompt de estrategia y juega por sí solo. Las partidas son para 4 jugadores, 25 turnos, con acciones simultáneas, niebla de guerra y diplomacia de texto libre entre turnos.

items.title: Chat AI Agent built into live Appium/mobile device sessions
items.raw_excerpt: We run a cloud device farm for mobile test automation (real Android/iOS devices, Selenium Grid, Appium). We just shipped a Chat AI Agent that lives inside every device session. It sees the live screen and answers questions like "what's the XPath for that button?" or "give me the UIAutomator2 selector for row 2" — with code output in Java, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or WebDriverIO. The implementation: we grab a frame from the WebRTC stream at query time and pass it to a vision LLM with a structured prompt. The model returns locators in all applicable formats (XPath, CSS, UIAutomator2, XCUITest, Accessibility ID). We parse and render with syntax highlighting. items.title: RunAnywhere (YC W26) – Faster AI Inference on Apple Silicon
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, we're Sanchit and Shubham (YC W26). We built a fast inference engine for Apple Silicon. LLMs, speech-to-text, text-to-speech – MetalRT beats llama.cpp, Apple's MLX, Ollama, and sherpa-onnx on every modality we tested. Custom Metal shaders, no framework overhead. Also, we've open-sourced RCLI, the fastest end-to-end voice AI pipeline on Apple Silicon. Mic to spoken response, entirely on-device. No cloud, no API keys. To get started: brew tap RunanywhereAI/rcli https://github.com/RunanywhereAI/RCLI.git brew install rcli rcli setup # downloads ~1 GB of models rcli # interactive mode with push-to-talk Or: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RunanywhereAI/RCLI/main/install.sh | bash The numbers (M4 Max, 64 GB, reproducible via `rcli bench`): LLM decode – 1.67x faster than llama.
